case.summary: The case was triggered by a real-time risk score of 0.90 for an online transaction of $99.92 on card C07987-K2 (customer C07987) using a new device profile. The graph showed that the device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720' was shared by 4 other connected cards, with near-identical purchases on 2 of those cards. The verdict is fraud with an initial and final fraud probability of 0.99, supported by case memory and device fan-out evidence. Actions taken include blocking the card (recommended, pending approval) and monitoring connected cards (auto).

sar.narrative: Customer C07987, holding card C07987-K2, was subjected to fraudulent online activity on 2016-12-01 at 17:28:53. An online transaction of $99.92 was executed using a new device profile 'Windows | other | chrome 61.0 | 1280x720'. This activity is highly suspicious as the transaction scored 0.90 via the bank model and 0.872 via the case-memory model, and the device is shared with 4 other cards in a coordinated clustering pattern involving near-identical amounts. The total exposure amount is $99.92. Actions taken include an automatic case creation, automatic monitoring of connected cards, and recommended card blocking and SAR filing under policy 3a and R6. How the 4 connected card(s) are linked: 4 card(s) use the same rare device profile as this card; 2 card(s) made a near-identical purchase within 48 hours on the same device profile.
